posts.zh:
dsh-wallpaper-engine 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。将 Wallpaper Engine 中已下载的壁纸用作 DeepSeek Harness 的背景：视频壁纸原位播放，图片壁纸优先使用最高分辨率原图，支持铺满/完整显示适配与 0–100 面板暗化。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7701bdab12fc0c293999.html
posts.en:
dsh-wallpaper-engine is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7701bdab12fc0c293999.html
